calculation.expression: rolling_sum_10(return_i - cross_sectional_median_return) / rolling_std_20(return_i), activated when cross_sectional_dispersion > rolling_quantile_252(dispersion, 0.60)
calculation.description: Volatility-scaled cross-sectional residual trend over ten sessions. The signal is available only during elevated cross-asset dispersion and predicts next-day returns. Positive values indicate relative leadership; the validated aggregate relation is negative, so consumers should use the factor direction as reversal/contrarian.

validation.regime_notes: Negative IC in all reported regimes: 2020-2022 -0.043500/ICIR -0.130877 (271 dates); 2023-2025 -0.022894/-0.074770 (424 dates); 2026-2031 -0.013524/-0.037723 (650 dates). Small 15-instrument universe warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation; the absolute IC and absolute ICIR pass the benchmark gates, while the factor must be consumed with reversal direction.
